recipe.title: Raspberry and peach oat crumble
recipe.intro: Midsummer brings the first big flush of British raspberries. Baked with ripe peaches under a crunchy oat topping, they make a warm afternoon snack everyone will want.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C fan, 200°C conventional.
Put the peach slices and raspberries in the baking dish. Add the lemon juice, caster sugar and cornflour, then toss gently so the raspberries mostly stay whole.
In a bowl, mix the flour, oats, almonds, brown sugar, cinnamon and salt. Pour in the oil and stir with a fork until it forms damp, crumbly clumps.
Scatter the topping evenly over the fruit, leaving a few gaps so the juices can bubble through.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is golden and crisp and the fruit is bubbling thickly at the edges.
Leave to cool for 10 minutes so the juices settle and thicken, then spoon into bowls.
recipe.tip: Swap the peaches for apricots or a handful of gooseberries. Leftovers keep in the fridge for three days and are lovely cold for breakfast.
